scope: Chromium browser development build with software WebGL; not Tauri desktop or hardware GPU acceptance
targetStatus: Q5 reference hardware/OS decision pending; measured results do not establish the PRD FPS/latency target

methods.load: From immediately before the real file chooser receives a .building ZIP until all objects and 20 textures are rendered; includes protocol file delivery and decoding/upload
methods.camera: Real right-button pointer drag with 100 moves and requested 15 ms waits, plus Playwright protocol delay. requestAnimationFrame observer reads renderer frameCount; durations are observed rendered-frame intervals, not maximum GPU throughput or GPU timer queries
methods.property: Capture-phase Enter key timestamp until changed document revision and first renderer frame are observed; includes command, scene update and render scheduling
methods.resources: Renderer.info.memory geometry and texture counts after the same selected wall is rendered at the end of each edit/delete/undo/floor cycle. GPU totals include Three.js internal DFG_LUT in addition to the 20 project textures; texture bytes and VRAM residency are not exposed by these counters
methods.exports: Five actual GLB downloads through the app export button, each validated independently with glTF Validator. Duration runs from before clicking Export to the browser download event; file copying and Validator execution are excluded

fixture.source: Original procedural brick PNGs; generated once per run, carried in the project ZIP

loadDistribution: One cold project-load observation; no load percentile distribution inferred
resourceResult: 50 cycles and 5 exports preserved the selected-wall geometry/texture counts and Renderer identity; this establishes no observed GPU counter growth in this workload, not total native memory or VRAM stability
